links.outcome: Association between reliability of Bing Chat cited sources and answer correctness
links.effect: Bing Chat cited at least one source for 836 of 913 questions; more reliable (peer-reviewed) sources were associated with higher likelihood of a correct response.
links.quote: The use of more reliable (peer-reviewed) sources was associated with higher likelihood of correct response.

links.outcome: Readability (SMOG grade level) of chatbot responses
links.effect: Bing Chat averaged grade 11.4 [95% CI 7.14, 15.7] versus ChatGPT-3.5 at 12.4 [95% CI 8.77, 16.1] (p < 0.0001).
links.quote: Bing Chat showed significantly better readability than ChatGPT-3.5, averaging a reading level of grade 11.4 [95% CI 7.14, 15.7] versus 12.4 [95% CI 8.77, 16.1], respectively (p-value < 0.0001, ρ = 0.25).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-3.5 and Bing Chat on 913 multiple-choice ophthalmology exam questions, comparing baseline accuracy, readability, and cited resources without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
